text:
Ronaldo walked out on Portugal. Coach Jorge Jesus says he owes no apology. Ronaldo's reply on Friday: goal number 980, in the 23rd minute for Al Nassr. Whose side are you on? 👇
#Ronaldo #CristianoRonaldo #Portugal #AlNassr #Football
titulo: Cristiano Ronaldo scores goal 980 after Jorge Jesus: 'I don't owe him an apology'
notas: Sky/Al Arabiya/beIN (980, minuto 23, 3-0 Al Diriyah); Gulf News cita de Jesus; jurado 3 subagentes r1 6,0 (noticia plana) -> comparativa r2 7,3
